lead.headline: Aircraft Guaranty Corp's trustee arm holds 364 live US plane registrations and added 38 in 2024-26, after 1 in 2021-23
lead.number: 364 valid, unexpired tail numbers at one Oklahoma City address; new certificates 2024: 6, 2025: 18, 2026: 14, against 1 in 2021 and 1 in 2023.
lead.watch_out: No skeptic has checked it; the conviction tie comes from press reports, not verified, and trustee registration is legal and common.
